Numbers come from docs/FACTS.md (eCFR text read 2026-11-17). build.mjs copies each ruleset into the matching peer network, so the peers and the built-in fallback never disagree. Set verified to false to make the screen show 'check'. medicare_advantage_rules was added 2026-11-17 from 42 CFR 422.582, 422.590 and 422.592 (eCFR 2026-11-01 edition, read by the owner).

aca_appeal_rules.title: Health plan appeal rules (ACA, non-grandfathered plans)
aca_appeal_rules.external_review_path: Insured plans follow the State external review process when the State has a qualifying one, and the Federal process otherwise. A State process must allow at least four months to file. Federal review: preliminary review in 5 business days, decision within 45 days, 72 hours when expedited.
aca_appeal_rules.after_appeal_note: If the plan does not follow the internal process, you are deemed to have exhausted it and may go straight to external review.

continued_coverage.text: Coverage continues while the appeal is decided.

full_review.text: The appeal review does not defer to the first denial.

urgent_path.text: An urgent care claim must be decided as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after receipt.

erisa_claims_rules.title: Employer health plan claims rules (ERISA)
erisa_claims_rules.external_review_path: Self-insured plans without an applicable State process use the Federal external review process, with an independent review organization accredited by URAC or a similar body. Same dates: four months to request, 5 business days preliminary review, 45 days standard, 72 hours expedited.
erisa_claims_rules.after_appeal_note: If the plan does not follow its claims procedures, you are deemed to have exhausted the plan's remedies and may bring a civil action under ERISA section 502(a).

medicare_advantage_rules.title: Medicare Advantage plan appeal rules (reconsideration)
medicare_advantage_rules.external_review_path: If the plan upholds its denial, it must send your case to an independent outside entity that has a contract with CMS. You do not file a separate request for outside review.
medicare_advantage_rules.after_appeal_note: If the plan misses its decision deadline, that counts as upholding the denial, and the plan must still send your case to the independent entity.

urgent_path.text: An expedited reconsideration is decided no later than 72 hours after the plan receives the request.

expedited_grant.text: The plan must grant an expedited reconsideration when the standard time could seriously jeopardize the life or health of the enrollee.
